title: Numeric event versions
spec: Implement ordered(events) returning a new list sorted by ascending numeric version. Each event is a dictionary with version as a non-negative base-10 integer string. Equal numeric versions retain input order. Do not modify input.
target_defect: Text ordering is used instead of numeric ordering, including numeric ties.
author_rationale: The change keeps sorting non-mutating and specifies an explicit key.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
